name: Mature Skin
description: Mature skin refers to the skin of individuals over 40 years old, characterized by signs of aging such as fine lines, wrinkles, loss of elasticity, and uneven pigmentation. It requires a targeted skincare approach focusing on hydration, firming, and protection.

morning_routine.action: Apply a hydrating moisturizer or cream
morning_routine.purpose: To lock in moisture and provide a base for makeup if needed

night_routine.action: Use an exfoliating toner to gently remove dead skin cells
night_routine.purpose: To promote cell turnover and improve texture

night_routine.action: Apply a retinoid serum or cream
night_routine.purpose: For its anti-aging benefits in the evening when skin is more receptive

weekly_care: Deep-cleansing facial every week to remove impurities and dead skin cells
lifestyle_tips: Hydration through drinking water and applying hydrating products
common_mistakes: Over-exfoliation leading to irritation or redness
Using heavy, occlusive products that can clog pores
do: Incorporate gentle exfoliation into your routine
Apply serums and creams containing active ingredients like retinoids and peptides
dont: Avoid using harsh products that can irritate the skin
Skip sun protection even on cloudy days
Discontinue use of all skincare products abruptly without consulting a dermatologist

seasonal_care.summer: Increase your sunscreen usage and look for lighter, more hydrating products to manage oiliness.
seasonal_care.winter: Use richer moisturizers and focus on nourishing ingredients to combat dryness.
seasonal_care.monsoon: Maintain regular use of retinoids but adjust the frequency of exfoliation steps based on skin sensitivity.

expert_tips: Personalize your skincare routine based on individual needs and concerns.
Patch test new products to avoid allergic reactions or sensitivities.
